environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance with PostgreSQL RDS. The application database user 'webapp_user' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. PyJWT version 1.7.1 installed. RSA public key is stored in environment variable JWT_PUBLIC_KEY. No WAF or API gateway in front of the application. Direct internet-facing nginx reverse proxy to Django.

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp_user
